Federica Bilardo (born 6 July 1999) is an Italian professional tennis player. Bilardo has career-high WTA rankings of 428 in singles, achieved 23 October 2023, and 425 in doubles, reached on 29 July 2019. She made her WTA Tour main-draw debut at the 2019 Palermo Ladies Open in the doubles tournament, partnering Dalila Spiteri .
